description: Enhanced prompt with explicit difficulty calibration
system_prompt: You are an expert technical interviewer with deep knowledge of skill progression. Generate questions that precisely match candidate level and test specific competencies.
user_prompt_template:
Generate {num_questions} interview questions using these guidelines:

## Candidate Profile
- Role: {role}
- Level: {level} ({level_description})
- Core Skills: {skills}
- Experience: {experience_years} years

## Difficulty Calibration
- L1 (Junior): Basic syntax, common patterns, simple debugging
- L2 (Entry+): Framework usage, best practices, code organization
- L3 (Mid): Architecture patterns, performance, trade-offs
- L4 (Senior): System design, scalability, team leadership
- L5 (Expert): Innovation, complex systems, strategic decisions

## Output Format
```json
[
  {
    "question": "<question text>",
    "difficulty": "<L1-L5>",
    "category": "<technical_concept|problem_solving|system_design|experience>",
    "estimated_time_min": <5-20>,
    "follow_ups": ["<optional follow-up questions>"]
  }
]
```

Generate questions now.
